publications.title: ZURLICA: Establishing a Research Lab for Intelligent Computing and Analytics at Zanzibar University
publications.abstract: This report outlines the vision, structure, research themes, postgraduate training model, and collaboration strategy for the Zanzibar University Research Lab for Intelligent Computing and Analytics.

publications.title: Toward Swahili Language AI for Public Health Communication in Zanzibar
publications.abstract: This study explores natural language processing methods for Swahili-language public health communication, including misinformation detection, sentiment analysis, and health education chatbots.

publications.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Coral Reef Monitoring Using Coastal Image Data
publications.abstract: This research investigates computer vision models for detecting coral reef degradation, classifying marine biodiversity, and supporting sustainable coastal management in Zanzibar.

publications.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Maternal Health Risk Prediction in Resource-Limited Settings
publications.abstract: This study aims to develop interpretable machine learning models for maternal health risk prediction using local clinical and community health data, with emphasis on privacy, fairness, and deployability.

publications.title: A Preliminary Dataset for Small-Scale Fisheries Analytics in Zanzibar
publications.abstract: This dataset collection supports research on catch prediction, fish species classification, market price analysis, and sustainable fisheries management in Zanzibar.

publications.title: Responsible AI and Data Governance Priorities for Zanzibar Institutions
publications.abstract: This policy brief examines ethical, legal, and institutional considerations for deploying AI and analytics systems in public sector and academic environments in Zanzibar.
